publication.title: Multicellular signaling and partial recovery define reverse cardiac remodeling

public_resources.data_statement: repository states that bulk RNA-seq counts/metadata and processed snRNA-seq AnnData are publicly available at Zenodo
public_resources.boundary: A public code repository and transcriptomic dataset statement do not substitute for a tissue-mechanics measurement.

experimental_root.model: reversible murine pressure overload using O-ring aortic banding followed by de-banding
experimental_root.phenotype: pressure overload induces heart failure; unloading produces partial functional recovery with regression of fibrosis and cardiomyocyte hypertrophy
experimental_root.bulk_transcriptomics: partial normalization of extracellular-matrix and metabolic pathways with persistent inflammatory and mitochondrial-dysfunction signatures
experimental_root.single_nucleus_transcriptomics: cardiomyocytes and endothelial cells largely re-establish homeostatic transcriptional states while fibroblasts retain activated remodeling-associated programs

mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M3_reason: Current public evidence confirms imposed-load removal and phenotypic reverse remodeling but no qualifying same-root quantitative tissue-stiffness/force trajectory before and after unloading was identified in this pass.
mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M4_reason: The key fibroblast result is persistence of activated transcriptional programs, not lineage-resolved disappearance, apoptosis, clearance or validated EXIT kinetics.

falsification_value.observation: Mechanical unloading and partial organ/ECM recovery do not force all cellular compartments back to a homeostatic state; fibroblasts can retain activated programs during recovery.
falsification_value.claim_ceiling: This preprint supports cell-type-specific persistence after unloading in this model; it does not prove a universal fibroblast memory mechanism and does not establish the causal molecular basis of persistence.

relation_to_existing_neff_root.reason: Neff 2022 supplies quantitative myocardial mechanics in a distinct TAC/unTAC experiment; Steier 2026 supplies transcriptomic cell-state resolution in a different experimental root. They cannot be combined to manufacture M3+M4 coupling.

next_exact_tests: resolve the exact Zenodo record and freeze dataset hashes/metadata if publicly accessible
inspect the preprint methods/source data for any same-root pressure, strain or myocardial stiffness measurement not surfaced in indexing
if no physical-state trajectory exists, retain this node only as a decoupling/hysteresis control
seek a future single-root unloading study combining serial myocardial mechanics with lineage-resolved fibroblast disappearance/apoptosis or state shutdown
